Queue: a bounded ordered collection with first-in-first-out (FIFO) behavior.
Enqueue inserts one item at the rear. Dequeue removes exactly the item at the front.
Front means the earliest remaining item; rear means the most recently inserted item.
If A arrives, then B, then C, the queue is A, B, C from front to rear.
The first dequeue returns A, leaving B, C. The second returns B, leaving C.
Dequeue is unavailable when empty. Enqueue is unavailable at the configured capacity.
Use a capacity of six items for an illustrative local learning model.
Reset restores the initial illustration A, B; it is a teaching action, not a queue operation.
Items are discrete labels: their order matters, not physical positions or motion.
